// Simple SHA-256 hashing using Web Crypto API
export async function hashString(str){const encoder=new TextEncoder();const data=encoder.encode(str);const hashBuffer=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',data);const hashArray=Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));return hashArray.map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');}
